notablePrerequisites: Sakashima of a Thousand Faces is a copy of The Locust God.
description:
Activate Tymora's Invoker by paying {8}, causing you to draw two cards.
The Locust God and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces each trigger twice.
Resolve each of the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and The Locust God triggers, creating a total of four 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing the Insects, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.
